instructionSummary:
create a local dashboard for image to video generation using AI model. here user will upload an image and it should generate the video. use this model to generate the video : https://civitai.red/models/2768012/complete-bedroom-prompt-collection-or-hetero-gay-and-lesbian-or-pony-diffusion

Branding colours: SaaS Momentum (#293681, #4274D9, #95CCD0, #DDE7E6). Recommended for dashboard, ai. Use these as brand direction while maintaining accessible text/background contrast.
